data.one_liner: Widget that displays animated emojis from the Noto Animated Emoji set
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple widget to show animated emojis with optional size, repeat, and skin tone variations. It can load emojis from assets for offline use and supports caching.
use_when: You need animated emojis in your UI
You want to customize size or repeat behavior
You need offline support for emojis
You want to use skin tone variations
avoid_when: Your app has very limited storage and cannot afford large asset bundles
You only need static emoji images
weaknesses: Requires manual asset import for offline support
No network fallback for missing assets
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, import assets in flutter section if offline support is needed
